request: Implement run(payload) in src/import_csv.py using the standard library. Input headers is a list of strings and rows is a list of lists. For each header, strip whitespace and lowercase; replace every consecutive run of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with exactly one underscore; strip underscores at both ends. Preserve the original header order and preserve rows unchanged. Return {"headers": normalized_headers, "rows": rows}. If any two normalized headers are equal, return only {"error":"DUPLICATE_HEADERS"}; do not remove duplicates. Preserve all public interfaces stated here. Python entrypoint is src.import_csv.run(payload). Inputs are JSON objects; return only plain JSON-compatible values (no Decimal objects, sets or tuples). Use only the standard library. Visible test tools check syntax only; functional verification is external.
title: Normalize CSV headers without losing rows
